summary.zh: 过去分词（Past Participles）是非谓语动词的重要形式，通常表示“被动”或“完成”的含义。它可以用于完成时、被动语态、形容词化修饰名词、分词短语作后置定语、原因状语、条件状语等结构。在 PTE Academic 和 IELTS 写作、阅读与听力中，过去分词常用于压缩句子信息、提高表达的学术性，例如 the data collected、policies implemented、issues discussed。中国学习者常见问题包括把过去分词和过去式混淆、遗漏 be 动词、误用主动含义，以及不会使用过去分词短语来改写定语从句。

structure.formula: regular verbs: verb + -ed；irregular verbs: past participle form，例如 written, taken, built, seen, found；常见结构包括 have/has/had + past participle, be + past participle, noun + past participle phrase, past participle phrase + main clause。
structure.explanation: 过去分词本身不是完整谓语，不能单独表示时态。它必须与助动词构成完成时，或与 be 动词构成被动语态，也可以像形容词一样修饰名词。其核心语义通常有两个：第一，表示动作已经完成，例如 the completed report；第二，表示名词承受某个动作，即被动关系，例如 the report written by the researcher。在学术英语中，过去分词常用于简化定语从句，如 the results that were obtained 可简化为 the results obtained，使句子更紧凑、更正式。

examples.en: The survey conducted in 2023 revealed a significant change in consumer behavior.
examples.zh: 2023年进行的调查显示，消费者行为发生了显著变化。

examples.en: The policy has been revised to address public concerns.
examples.zh: 该政策已经被修订，以回应公众关切。

examples.en: Written in clear academic language, the report is suitable for publication.
examples.zh: 由于用清晰的学术语言写成，这份报告适合发表。

usage_scenarios.title: 用于完成时：have/has/had + past participle
usage_scenarios.description: 过去分词与 have、has 或 had 连用，构成现在完成时、过去完成时等，强调动作与某个时间点之间的联系，常用于 IELTS Task 1 描述趋势变化，也常见于 PTE Summarize Written Text 中。

examples.en: The number of international students has increased steadily over the past decade.
examples.zh: 在过去十年里，国际学生人数稳步增长。

examples.en: By the time the policy was introduced, the problem had already worsened.
examples.zh: 到该政策推出时，问题已经恶化。

usage_scenarios.title: 用于被动语态：be + past participle
usage_scenarios.description: 当句子重点是动作的承受者，而不是动作执行者时，使用被动语态。学术写作中被动语态常用于强调研究、数据、政策和结果，而非个人行为。

examples.en: The experiment was designed to test the reliability of the new method.
examples.zh: 该实验被设计用来测试新方法的可靠性。

examples.en: Several recommendations were made based on the findings.
examples.zh: 根据研究结果提出了若干建议。

usage_scenarios.title: 作前置定语：past participle + noun
usage_scenarios.description: 过去分词可以放在名词前，像形容词一样修饰名词，通常表达“已经被……的”或“处于某种状态的”含义。这类结构在阅读文章标题、图表描述和学术摘要中非常常见。

examples.en: Developed countries often have more advanced healthcare systems.
examples.zh: 发达国家通常拥有更先进的医疗体系。

examples.en: A balanced diet is essential for long-term health.
examples.zh: 均衡饮食对长期健康至关重要。

usage_scenarios.title: 作后置定语：noun + past participle phrase
usage_scenarios.description: 当过去分词带有宾语、状语或介词短语时，通常放在名词之后，相当于一个省略了 which/that + be 的定语从句。这是学术英语中提升句子密度的重要方式。

examples.en: The data collected from rural areas were analyzed separately.
examples.zh: 从农村地区收集的数据被单独分析。

examples.en: The measures adopted by the government helped reduce unemployment.
examples.zh: 政府采取的措施有助于降低失业率。

usage_scenarios.title: 作状语：表示原因、条件或让步
usage_scenarios.description: 过去分词短语可放在句首或句中，表示原因、条件、时间或让步。其逻辑主语通常与主句主语一致，并且主句主语是过去分词动作的承受者。

examples.en: Given sufficient funding, the project could be completed within two years.
examples.zh: 如果获得充足资金，该项目可以在两年内完成。

examples.en: Compared with traditional methods, this approach is more cost-effective.
examples.zh: 与传统方法相比，这种方法更具成本效益。

usage_scenarios.title: 用于形容词化表达
usage_scenarios.description: 许多过去分词已经形容词化，用来描述人的感受、事物状态或客观特征。需要注意，-ed 形式常描述人的感受，-ing 形式常描述事物令人产生某种感受。

examples.en: Many students felt confused by the complex instructions.
examples.zh: 许多学生对复杂的说明感到困惑。

examples.en: The participants were satisfied with the training programme.
examples.zh: 参与者对培训项目感到满意。

common_mistakes.wrong: The report was write by the committee.
common_mistakes.correct: The report was written by the committee.
common_mistakes.explanation: 被动语态必须使用 be + past participle。write 的过去分词是不规则形式 written，不能用原形 write，也不能只用过去式 wrote。

common_mistakes.wrong: The data collected from the survey is reliable.
common_mistakes.correct: The data collected from the survey are reliable.
common_mistakes.explanation: 在正式学术英语中，data 通常被视为复数，因此谓语动词应使用 are。过去分词短语 collected from the survey 只是后置定语，不决定主谓一致。

common_mistakes.wrong: The problem discussed it in the meeting was serious.
common_mistakes.correct: The problem discussed in the meeting was serious.
common_mistakes.explanation: 过去分词短语作后置定语时，名词 the problem 已经是 discussed 的逻辑宾语，不能再加 it。中文学习者常受“讨论它”的表达影响而重复宾语。

common_mistakes.wrong: Because affected by pollution, many species disappeared.
common_mistakes.correct: Affected by pollution, many species disappeared.
common_mistakes.explanation: 过去分词短语作原因状语时，通常不直接与 because 连用。若要使用 because，应写成 because they were affected by pollution。

common_mistakes.wrong: The government has took several actions.
common_mistakes.correct: The government has taken several actions.
common_mistakes.explanation: 完成时结构是 have/has + past participle。take 的过去分词是 taken，不是过去式 took。

common_mistakes.wrong: Compared to last year, the company increased its profit.
common_mistakes.correct: Compared with last year, the company's profit increased.
common_mistakes.explanation: Compared with/to 引导的分词短语，其逻辑主语应与主句主语一致。被比较的是 profit，而不是 company 本身，因此应调整主句主语，避免 dangling participle。

common_mistakes.wrong: The students were boring during the lecture.
common_mistakes.correct: The students were bored during the lecture.
common_mistakes.explanation: bored 表示“感到无聊的”，描述人的感受；boring 表示“令人无聊的”，描述事物特征。这里主语是 students，应使用 bored。

pte_usage.description: 过去分词在 PTE Academic 中非常常见，尤其出现在 Read Aloud、Repeat Sentence、Summarize Written Text、Write Essay、Reading Fill in the Blanks 和 Listening Fill in the Blanks 中。考生需要识别过去分词与谓语动词的区别，判断被动语态、完成时和后置定语结构。在写作中，恰当使用过去分词短语可以减少冗余从句，提高语法多样性和信息密度，例如将 the policies that were implemented by the government 改为 the policies implemented by the government。
sections: Read Aloud：准确朗读过去分词结尾 -ed，包括 /t/、/d/、/ɪd/ 的发音差异
Repeat Sentence：听辨完成时和被动语态，如 has been developed, was introduced
Summarize Written Text：用过去分词短语压缩原文信息，形成一句完整复杂句
Write Essay：使用被动语态和后置分词短语表达客观观点
Reading Fill in the Blanks：根据语法位置判断应填过去分词、过去式还是形容词
Listening Fill in the Blanks：注意不规则过去分词的拼写，如 written, chosen, driven, found

academic_patterns.pattern: The data collected from X indicate that ...
The results obtained from the study suggest that ...
academic_patterns.translation: 该研究获得的结果表明……

academic_patterns.pattern: The measures implemented by the government have led to ...
academic_patterns.translation: 政府实施的措施已经导致……

academic_patterns.pattern: Compared with previous studies, this research provides ...
academic_patterns.translation: 与以往研究相比，本研究提供了……

academic_patterns.pattern: Given the limited evidence, it is difficult to conclude that ...
academic_patterns.translation: 鉴于证据有限，很难得出……的结论。

academic_patterns.pattern: The issue discussed above is closely related to ...
academic_patterns.translation: 上述讨论的问题与……密切相关。

academic_patterns.pattern: The approach adopted in this paper aims to ...
Resources allocated to education can improve ...
academic_patterns.translation: 分配给教育的资源能够改善……

ai_tips: 判断过去分词时，先看它是否与名词构成被动关系。例如 the book written by the author 中，book 是“被写”的对象，因此 written 是过去分词。
写作中可以把 which/that + be 定语从句压缩成过去分词短语，例如 the method that was used in the study 可改为 the method used in the study。
不要把过去式和过去分词混为一谈。过去式可单独作谓语，如 The policy changed；过去分词通常需要助动词或用于修饰，如 has changed, the changed policy。
遇到句首过去分词短语时，检查主句主语是否是该动作的承受者。若逻辑主语不一致，句子会出现 dangling participle。

practice_questions.question: 将句子改写为使用过去分词后置定语：The report that was written by the research team highlights several risks.
practice_questions.answer: The report written by the research team highlights several risks.

practice_questions.question: 选择正确形式：The policy has been (introduce / introduced / introducing) to reduce traffic congestion.
practice_questions.answer: introduced。句子是现在完成被动结构 has been + past participle。

practice_questions.question: 判断并改错：The information provided it by the university is useful.
practice_questions.answer: 错误。应改为：The information provided by the university is useful. 过去分词 provided 已经修饰 information，不能再加 it。

practice_questions.question: 用过去分词短语翻译：与传统教学方法相比，在线学习更加灵活。
practice_questions.answer: Compared with traditional teaching methods, online learning is more flexible.

practice_questions.question: 选择正确表达：The students were (confusing / confused) by the new assessment criteria.
practice_questions.answer: confused。学生是感到困惑的人，应使用 -ed 形式。

practice_questions.question: 改写为更学术的表达：The government used several strategies, and these strategies improved public health.
practice_questions.answer: The strategies adopted by the government improved public health.

practice_questions.question: 填空：The results ______ from the experiment support the original hypothesis. 使用 obtain 的正确形式。
practice_questions.answer: obtained。The results obtained from the experiment support the original hypothesis.

practice_questions.question: 判断逻辑是否正确并改写：Compared with last month, the company sold more products.
practice_questions.answer: 逻辑不够准确。可改为：Compared with last month, product sales increased. 被比较的是销量，而不是公司本身。
